❌ Legacy SIP URI-List INVITE Failure Modes (RFC 5366 / RFC 4826)
1. Single-INVITE 1->500 Dial-Out Amplification: Packing 500 <entry> URIs
into one resource-lists+xml body exhausts SIP trunks and enables toll fraud.
2. <entry-ref> / <external> XCAP SSRF: Dereferencing external XML list
anchors over HTTP triggers internal IMDS SSRF and recursive list loops.
3. copyControl="bcc" Supervisor Identity Leak: Naive focus broadcasts
hidden bcc compliance supervisors inside RFC 4575 conference-info NOTIFYs.
Result: 500x dial-out storm + XCAP SSRF + bcc supervisor identity leak
✅ Deterministic P1007–P1008 🎉 (510 Dims!) URI-List & bcc Gate
1. P1007 (1,016th Guard) Inline Allowlist & [1,8] Target Cap: Forbid
<entry-ref>/<external> SSRF, verify domain allowlist & cap entries ∈ [1, 8].
2. P1008 🎉 (🎉 510th Dim / 1,017th Guard) bcc Privacy & [1,4] calls/s Pace:
Omit bcc nodes from non-moderator NOTIFYs & pace dial-outs ∈ [1, 4] calls/s.
3. Deduplicated Non-isfocus Dialing: Strip duplicate URIs and self/peer
isfocus URIs before initiating outbound consultation INVITE transactions.
Result: 0 entry-ref SSRF · 0 bcc identity leaks · targets ∈ [1, 8]
